## Inline text

Regular, **bold**, *italic*, ***bold italic***, ~~strikethrough~~, `inline code`, and a [link to the overview](../) plus an [external link](https://github.com/liara-engine/docs-shared) — which should carry an external-link affordance.

A very long line of `inline code that should wrap rather than overflow its container on a narrow viewport, because API names get long`.

- **`liara_result`**

## Footnotes

## Inline HTML

<kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>K</kbd> opens search. Superscripts (x<sup>2</sup>),
subscripts (H<sub>2</sub>O) and <abbr title="Application Binary Interface">ABI</abbr>
abbreviations all survive the Markdown pipeline.

## Long paragraph

The measure of a body column should stay readable without the reader having to track a line back across the full width of a desktop display; this paragraph exists to make that visible at a glance, and to give the dyslexia-friendly font something long enough to be judged on. If the line length here looks comfortable in every theme, at every width, then the layout tokens are doing their job and nothing on this page needs attention.
